name: familyhouse_exterior
description: The cozy outdoor home of a gentle animal family where many everyday adventures begin.

color_palette: Soft sage green (#8A9A5B) for the house shutters and garden plants
Warm terracotta (#CC7357) for the roof tiles and flower pots
Creamy white (#F5F5DC) for the main house walls
visual_style.architectural_style: A charming, small-scale cottage with a pitched roof, wide eaves, and shuttered windows. The design is simple and welcoming, with a small front porch and stone foundation. All structures are proportioned for small animal inhabitants with childlike perspectives in mind.
visual_style.flora_fauna: A well-tended garden with sunflowers, lavender, and low berry bushes surrounds the house. Robins and butterflies are commonly seen, while small woodland creatures like bunnies and squirrels visit from nearby.
materials: White-washed stone forms the base of the house
Natural wood siding on the upper walls
Small cobblestones create the garden pathway
